info.title: PeopleForce MCP REST API
info.description: REST data plane for the PeopleForce HRIS: employees, leave, org reference data, performance objectives and KPIs, the knowledge base, and the recruitment pipeline. Reads exist so a shell-capable client can curl | jq bulk payloads without them crossing the LLM context window; every read also accepts format=text to get the same markdown the MCP tool renders. Writes are validated with the MCP tools' own Zod schemas.

get.summary: List PeopleForce employees
get.description: List PeopleForce employees

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Page size is fixed by PeopleForce.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Cohort filter. Omitting this returns ACTIVE employees only, not everyone — there is no "all". A full headcount is one pass with active plus one with inactive. Use probation for the current probation cohort in a single call.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text/plain/markdown to receive the same markdown the MCP tool renders instead of JSON. Accept: text/plain works too.

200.description: Raw upstream PeopleForce payload, or markdown when format=text.

schema.description: The same markdown the MCP tool renders. Returned when format=text.

403.description: No PeopleForce connection on this account, or upstream denied the call.

schema.description: The same markdown the MCP tool renders. Returned when format=text.

post.description: Create a PeopleForce leave request. Returns 201 with the created request. leaveTypeId comes from the leave-types endpoint, not the type name.

201.description: Write succeeded. Returns the affected resource re-read from PeopleForce.

schema.description: The same markdown the MCP tool renders. Returned when format=text.

400.description: Invalid query or request body. Body failures include Zod issues from flatten().

403.description: No PeopleForce connection on this account, or upstream denied the call.

requestBody.description: Validated with the MCP tool's own Zod schema. Path parameters override same-named body keys.

employeeId.description: The employee the leave request is for.

leaveTypeId.description: The leave-type ID from the leave-types endpoint — NOT the type name.

startsOn.description: First day of leave (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a real calendar date.

endsOn.description: Last day of leave (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be on or after startsOn.
